notes.title: First update for VRDrivers!
notes.content:
[h1]It's the first update for VRDrivers! We have changed and added the following:[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]added hands on the steering wheel[/b]
[*] [b]now you can change difficulty level[/b]
[*] [b]faster navigation in menu[/b]
[*] [b]improved pause menu[/b]
[*] [b]fixed some bugs[/b]
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30711291/667b99c2b27d884c303d427ed1208d2359b2bba1.png[/img]
